blocks.p: Classe = modele. Objet = instance creee par new.

blocks.code:
<?php
class Fruit {
    public string $name;
    public string $color;

    public function setName(string $n): void {
        $this->name = $n;
    }

    public function getName(): string {
        return $this->name;
    }
}

$apple = new Fruit();
$apple->setName('Apple');
echo $apple->getName();
